The spec is the approved plan (r4) with its close amendments A1 to A5 in section 13; rows tagged (o) and the owner rulings quoted in section 8 are not re-argued. close-results.md says the last repair of each phase was read by no reviewer (LR1 60306a5c, LR2 45551cf1, LR3 aec93739). Read that code and those pages especially.
Check that the pages, the reference set README and notes/issue-reply.md state nothing the code, the recorded run or GND does not do, and present no figure as a claim about other corpora or models.
